name: Hill AFB
description: Home to the Ogden Air Logistics Complex and major aircraft maintenance for Air Force Materiel Command. Supports F-35, T-7A, and other critical programs. Largest single-site employer in Utah.

currentNotifications.title: T-7A and F-35 Campus Construction
currentNotifications.body: Groundbreaking and ongoing construction for new T-7A and F-35 facilities. Expect minor traffic impacts in east campus areas.

gates.name: South Gate (Main 24/7)
gates.notes: Primary 24/7 gate. Recommended for first-time arrivals. South Gate Visitor Center Mon-Fri 0700-1600.

gates.name: South Gate Visitor Center
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1600; closed weekends and federal holidays
gates.notes: Day passes and visitor registration. Open on AFMC Family Days. Phone: 801-777-8631.

gates.name: West Gate (Main)
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0400-2200; Sat-Sun 0800-1800; closed federal holidays and AFMC Family Days
gates.notes: High-traffic commuter gate with Visitor Center access.

gates.name: North Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0430-1700; closed weekends and federal holidays; open AFMC Family Days
gates.notes: Commercial vehicle inspections Mon-Fri 0600-1500. After-hours commercial contact BDOC 801-777-3058.

gates.name: Roy Gate
gates.hours: Mon-Fri 0400-2000; closed weekends and federal holidays

gates.name: Southwest Gate
gates.notes: Limited weekday access. Closed weekends and federal holidays.

resources.hours: Mon-Fri: Bfast 0530-0800, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1700-1900; Sat-Sun: Bfast 0800-0930, Lunch 1100-1300, Dinner 1700-1830
resources.address: 5757 D Ave, Bldg 519, Hill AFB, UT 84056

resources.name: Fast Eddies Dining Facility
resources.description: Secondary DFAC serving Hill AFB personnel.
resources.hours: See Hill FSS for posted meal hours

resources.name: Hill AFB Main Exchange (BX)
resources.description: Hill AFB Main Exchange with food court (Burger King, Popeye's), barber, beauty shop, optical, and GNC.

resources.name: Hill AFB Commissary
resources.address: 7451 S 1500 W, Bldg 450, Hill AFB, UT 84056

resources.name: Utah First Credit Union
resources.description: On-base federal credit union with checking, savings, loans, and 24/7 ATM access.

resources.name: Main BX ATM (24/7)
resources.description: 24/7 ATM located at the Main Exchange.

resources.name: Warrior Fitness Center
resources.description: Main staffed fitness center. Register CAC here for 24/7 Hess Fitness Center access.

resources.name: Unaccompanied Housing / Dorm Management
resources.description: Dormitory management and assignments for unaccompanied personnel.

resources.name: Falcon Hill Inn (AF Lodging)
resources.description: Official temporary lodging and TLF. 24-hour front desk for arrivals.
resources.hours: Lodging desk open 24 hours daily; check-in 1400, check-out 1100

resources.name: Military & Family Readiness Center (M&FRC)
resources.description: Relocation assistance, financial counseling, employment support, family programs, and Total Force readiness.

resources.name: 75th Force Support Squadron (FSS)
resources.description: Full MWR, dining, fitness, lodging, recreation, and family support programs.
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0730-1630; facility hours on FSS website directory

resources.name: Outdoor Recreation (ODR)
resources.description: Equipment rental, RV storage, FamCamp, and recreational programs.

resources.name: Hill AFB Golf Course
resources.description: 18-hole golf course with pro shop and dining.

resources.name: 75th Medical Group
resources.description: Primary care, specialty clinics, and TRICARE services.

resources.name: Visitor Control Center
resources.hours: Mon-Fri 0700-1600; closed weekends and federal holidays

resources.name: Hess Fitness Center (24/7)
resources.description: 24/7 fitness access for active duty, DoD civilians, and retirees. Register CAC at Warrior Fitness Center during staffed hours.
resources.hours: 24/7 CAC access after registration at Warrior Fitness Center

resources.name: Finance Office (Comptroller)
resources.description: Military pay, travel vouchers, and finance customer service.

resources.name: Military Personnel Flight (MPF)
resources.description: ID cards, DEERS, assignments, and personnel actions.

events.description: Youth Center Friday Night Frenzy (sports, arts, classes); hillfss.com. Page time fields mixed—confirm 1800-2100 on site.

events.title: Big Buck Bingo at The Landing
events.description: Recurring Tue/Thu bingo; DoD cardholders; 75 FSS.

sections.title: Required Documents
sections.body: PCS orders, CAC, medical/dental records, marriage and birth certificates if applicable, and travel receipts for finance settlement.

sections.title: Housing
sections.body: Contact Dormitory Management (801-777-5218) for unaccompanied housing or Falcon Inn (801-777-3311) for temporary lodging. Family housing through Liberty Military Housing.

sections.title: Quick Resources
sections.body: 75 FSS, M&FRC, and official Hill AFB sites for in-processing and community support.

sections.title: In-Processing Schedule
sections.body: Report to your gaining unit upon arrival and visit MPF within required timelines. Contact base lodging for after-hours arrivals.

sections.title: Sponsor Program
sections.body: Your sponsor should meet you upon arrival. Contact M&FRC if no sponsor is assigned before departure.
